plan.title: bug(swarm): finalize-cohort refuses a deft-story mark until productPullRequest is stamped, but nothing can stamp it first

narratives.Description: swarm:finalize-cohort refuses a `deft-story: N` mark on a product PR unless a brief for N already has `metadata.productPullRequest` equal to that PR, but Path B activation leaves the stamp unset and finalize only stamps it later in its own sweep. This story lets the mark bind when the operator names N in `--stories` and the PR passed delivery validation, so finalize can stamp the brief and complete it. A mark for an issue outside `--stories` keeps the #4864 fail-closed error, and a brief already stamped to a different PR is still refused.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`swarm:finalize-cohort` cannot complete a Path B story whose product PR carries `deft-story: N`. Seen on this repo, 2026-11-12: cohort #5882 (PR #6210) and #6203 (PR #6211), both merged.

Finalize checks every `deft-story: N` mark on a product PR before it does anything else. The mark binds only when an active or completed brief for N already has `metadata.productPullRequest` equal to that PR (#4864, `deftStoryMarkBindsDelivery`). Otherwise finalize adds an error and skips the sweep.

Nothing can set that field first:

1. Path B activation leaves `productPullRequest` unset (#5387).
2. No verb stamps it. `scope:stamp-evidence` writes evidence only.
3. Finalize stamps it itself (`stampProductPullRequestOnBriefFile`), but only inside the sweep, after the mark check has already failed.
4. With more than one brief in `active/`, the #4007 write fence and the #5656 prospective scope-cover deny any Write, Edit or commit of an active brief. That holds for pinned workers too, because the brief is outside the story's `file_scope`, and for an operator worktree outside the repo root.

So the check needs the stamp, and only the check's own success leads to the stamp.

Workers cannot use `Closes #N` instead: `pr:check-closing-keywords` refuses it while the brief is active (#3015). That makes `deft-story: N` the only full-story mark a product PR can carry.

## Evidence

`task swarm:finalize-cohort -- --stories 5882 --pr 6210 --repo deftai/directive --dry-run`:

```
#5882: deft-story mark on PR #6210 does not bind PR delivery (need active or completed brief #5882 with metadata.productPullRequest=6210) (#4864).
```

The same happens for #6203 / #6211. Without the mark, the single-PR path (`--stories N --pr M`, no closing refs) would bind the PR's evidence, stamp `productPullRequest` in the lifecycle checkout, and record merge evidence.

## Expected

- When the operator pairs `--stories N` with `--pr M`, and M is merged and passes delivery validation, a `deft-story: N` mark on M binds without a prior stamp. Finalize then stamps `productPullRequest=M` in the lifecycle checkout, as it does today.
- A mark naming an issue outside `--stories` keeps today's fail-closed behavior, so an unrelated completed issue is never closed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `swarm:finalize-cohort -- --stories N --pr M` completes a Path B brief whose PR M carries `deft-story: N` and whose brief has no `productPullRequest`.
- The completed brief has `metadata.productPullRequest = M` and merge evidence on each item.
- A `deft-story: K` mark on M for a K not in `--stories` still fails with the #4864 error.

## Related

#4864 (deft-story delivery bind), #5387 (activation leaves the stamp unset), #4007 (multi-active write fence), #5656 (prospective scope-cover), #5710 (delivery identity), #680 (lifecycle PR overhead), #6209 (`swarm:launch` worktree gap).
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer finalizing a shipped Path B story, I want a `deft-story: N` mark on the merged product PR to bind when I pass `--stories N --pr M`, so that swarm:finalize-cohort stamps productPullRequest and completes the brief instead of refusing.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts, before the per-PR loop, resolve the operator `--stories` tokens to their issue numbers. Extend deftStoryMarkBindsDelivery so a mark for an issue in that set binds when a nonterminal brief for the issue has no productPullRequest, and refuses when any brief for the issue is stamped to a different PR. Marks for issues outside the operator set keep today's #4864 check unchanged. The existing sweep stamp (stampProductPullRequestOnBriefFile) then records productPullRequest=M. Add focused vitest cases in finalize-cohort.test.ts and a CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed line.
narratives.DesignCritique: design-critique: not warranted, because #6212 is a narrow bug with one bounded remedy stated in the issue, and the operator directed through-merge.
